title: appointment.noshow v1
description: Emitted when an appointment transitions to no-show (scheduled->noshow; appointments.ex maybe_publish_status/3 -> publisher.publish_appointment_noshow/1, appointments.ex:786). Source publisher: alebrije-mod-agenda-ex EventPublisher.publish_appointment_noshow/1 -> publish/2 (event_publisher.ex:23,50-51,65-73,97). FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer: publish/2 stamps event_type onto the flat field map (envelope = Map.put(payload, "event_type", stream)) and the shared AlebrijeCommon.EventBus.Producer XADDs it. The on-the-wire event_type EN-USO is 'appointment.noshow' — the @noshow_stream literal (event_publisher.ex:23), confirmed by lifecycle_event_type("noshow") (appointments.ex:768) — NOT 'agenda.appointment.no_show'. Canonicalised 2026-06-26 (#177) to the name the producer actually publishes: the prior 'agenda.appointment.no_show' registration was an aspirational ADR-31 name no producer ever XADDs, and its only subscribers (agentic CrossModuleEventConsumer + mcp-go eventbridge) were dead-wires on an empty/phantom stream, both since removed in code. The producer stringifies every field via to_string(value || ""), so optional fields arrive as empty strings, never null. The producer's own comment (appointments.ex maybe_publish_status/3) names rewards-go / crm-go / notifications-ex as the intended cross-module consumers — none subscribe yet (no consumers.yaml entry).

event_type.description: Canonical event_type EN-USO stamped by EventPublisher.publish/2 (envelope = Map.put(payload, "event_type", @noshow_stream)). Consumers route on this exact value.

appointment_id.description: UUID of the appointment that went no-show. Producer stringifies appt.id (event_publisher.ex:67); empty string when absent.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the appointment (ADR-25). Producer stringifies appt.tenant_id (event_publisher.ex:68); empty string when absent.

calendar_id.description: Calendar the appointment belongs to. Producer stringifies appt.calendar_id (event_publisher.ex:69); empty string when absent.

contact_phone.description: E.164 contact phone on the appointment. Producer stringifies appt.contact_phone (event_publisher.ex:70); empty string when absent.

status.description: Appointment status at emit time; 'noshow' for this event (event_publisher.ex:71).
